description: Drop a TouchDesigner Engine COMP that loads an external .tox in a separate TD subprocess — an independent crash domain with its own cook + (optionally) a second GPU thread, ideal for hosting heavy or unstable subgraphs. Sets the .tox file, optional reload pulse (re-pulls the .tox once), perform-mode override, and color-map toggle. The .tox's own outTOP/outCHOP/outSOP/outDAT operators surface as connectors on the Engine COMP for downstream wiring. Complements make_portable_tox (which produces the shippable .tox). Note: sub-process spin-up forks a TD process — the first cook can be multi-second on slow disks; that is not a hang. par.reload / par.usecolormap / par.performmode are guarded with hasattr so unverified par names degrade to warnings rather than throwing.

name.description: Node name for the new Engine COMP.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the Engine COMP is created inside (default '/project1').

perform_mode.description: 'on' forces the sub-engine to cook in perform mode; 'off' forces it off; 'auto' leaves the par at its default. (UNVERIFIED par name 'performmode' — guarded with hasattr).

reload.description: When true, pulse the Engine COMP's reload par so the .tox is re-pulled once at creation.

tox_path.description: Path to the .tox file the sub-engine loads. Forward-slash recommended; absolute or project-relative.

use_color_map.description: Mirror the Engine COMP's color-map toggle (UNVERIFIED par name 'usecolormap' — guarded with hasattr).
